subject: english
question:
**In the given sentence the underlined word may have been incorrectly spelt. Identify the option that rectifies the spelling. If there is no error in spelling, select 'No error'.**

Siraz-ud-Daula __beseiged__ Calcutta to take punitive actions against the East India Company.
solution:
The correct answer is **besieged**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The correct spelling and meaning of the underlined word are as follows: 
 
• **Besieged: **past tense of besiege; to surround a place with an army. (सेना की सहायता से किसी स्‍थान को घेर लेना, घेराबंदी करना)
 
 
• *Example: The army had **besieged** the castle.*
 
 
 
• Thus, the option that rectifies the spelling of the underlined word is **option 3**. 

30:T486,
The correct answer is **adolescent**.
